build_grid_assigner: build a GridAssigner instance with pos_iou_thr and neg_iou_thr for grid-based bbox assignment
assign_gt_to_bboxes: assign ground truth bboxes to proposals using GridAssigner assign method with responsible flags
configure_iou_thresholds: configure positive and negative IoU thresholds for grid assigner to control sample assignment
